link.title: Delete my account
link.hint: Permanently delete your account, profile and content. This cannot be undone.

accountDeletion.title: Delete my account
accountDeletion.intro: This page lets you request the permanent deletion of your Upmina Community account. Please read it carefully: deletion is irreversible.
accountDeletion.warningsTitle: What happens if you delete your account

warnings.irreversible: It is irreversible. Once confirmed there is no grace period, cancellation or restoration, not even by the team.
warnings.access: You lose access immediately: your sessions are closed and you will not be able to sign in with this account again.
warnings.deleted: Your profile, posts, likes and the files you uploaded are removed through a cleanup process that continues after access is blocked.
warnings.username: Your username becomes available and someone else can register it. That person does not inherit anything from your account.
warnings.retained: Moderation records, copyright claims and audit records needed for justified reasons may be kept under restricted access. Existing sanctions are not cancelled by deleting the account.
warnings.cleanup: Internal cleanup may take time and continue after access is blocked; you do not need to keep this page open.
warnings.limits: Backups, caches and signed links that were already issued may persist for a while until they expire or rotate; they are not erased instantly.

accountDeletion.privacyLink: How we handle your data (privacy policy)

signIn.title: Sign in to continue
signIn.body: To delete an account you must sign in with that same account. If you came from the email link, come back here after signing in.

privileged.title: Team-role accounts follow a different procedure
privileged.body: Your account has a Developer, Admin or Moderator role. For security, these accounts cannot be deleted from here: they require a separate administrative procedure. There is no way to bypass this restriction from the interface.

request.intro: We will send you an email (in English) with a confirmation link valid for 30 minutes. Nothing is deleted until you open the link, sign in with this account and confirm explicitly.

sent.title: Check your email
sent.body: If everything went well, you will receive a message with the confirmation link. It expires in 30 minutes and works only once. Nothing has been deleted yet.

requestErrors.rateLimited: You have requested too many emails. Wait a moment before trying again.
requestErrors.mailFailed: The email could not be sent. Nothing has been deleted. Please try again in a few minutes.
requestErrors.unavailable: The service is unavailable right now. Nothing has been deleted.
requestErrors.alreadyDeleting: This account is already being deleted.
requestErrors.generic: The request could not be processed. Nothing has been deleted.

valid.title: Confirm permanent deletion
valid.body: The link is valid. If you continue, your account will be blocked immediately and permanently deleted. There is no going back.
valid.ack: I understand this is irreversible: I will lose access to my account, my content will be deleted and I will not be able to recover it.

expired.title: The link has expired
expired.body: Confirmation links expire after 30 minutes. Nothing has been deleted. You can request a new email.

invalid.title: We could not validate this link
invalid.body: The link is not valid, was already used, was replaced by a newer one, or belongs to a different account than the one you are signed in with. Nothing has been deleted.
invalid.signOut: Sign out and use another account

confirmErrors.invalid: The link is no longer valid. Nothing has been deleted.
confirmErrors.expired: The link has expired. Nothing has been deleted.
confirmErrors.generic: The confirmation could not be completed. We have no record that the account was deleted; you can try again.

ambiguous.title: We could not confirm the outcome
ambiguous.body: The connection was lost while the request was being processed, so we do not know whether the deletion was accepted. We do not claim that the account was deleted, nor that it was not. Check the status: if it was already blocked, you will see it here.

deleting.title: Your account has been blocked and is being deleted
deleting.body: Access to this account is already blocked and cannot be restored. The cleanup of your data continues in the background and you do not need to do anything else or keep this page open.
deleting.retained: Some restricted records may be kept for justified reasons. Backups and links that were already issued may take time to disappear.

developer.title: Pending account deletions
developer.intro: Irreversible deletion requests whose cleanup failed, is retrying or has stalled. The account of each request is already blocked: nothing here can restore access or delete arbitrary users. No identities are shown.
developer.empty: There are no deletions needing attention.
developer.error: The alert list could not be loaded.

retry.confirmBody: The job will be rescheduled so the worker repeats only the pending stages. It does not restore the account's access.
retry.requested: Retry requested. This does not mean the cleanup has finished; refresh the list later.
retry.notApplicable: This request no longer accepts a retry (it is running or completed).
retry.forbidden: You do not have permission for this action.
retry.failed: The retry could not be requested.
